title: Power to take fingerprints
question: What does Police Act 2020 section 68 say about power to take fingerprints?
shortAnswer: Police Act 2020 s.68 — Fingerprints of arrested persons; destruction if acquitted.
legalExplanation:
**Section 68 of the Nigeria Police Act 2020** provides:

Fingerprints of arrested persons; destruction if acquitted

This section is part of the Police Act 2020 which replaced the old Police Act Cap P19 LFN 2004. It aims to provide a more efficient police service based on accountability, human rights protection, and community partnership.
